connection_condition: cards.setCode corresponds to sets.code; every card printing resolves to exactly one set.
description: A set is composed of its card printings. Each card printing belongs to exactly one set, and a printing removed from its set would lose its printing identity.
A card printing's foreign-language renditions are components of that printing; a foreign_data record cannot exist without its card, other than for 16 orphan rows.
Rulings are components attached to a card printing; every ruling row belongs to exactly one card printing.
The localized names of a set are components of that set record; a set translation cannot exist without its set.

connection_condition: legalities.uuid corresponds to cards.uuid, and legalities.format names the format; the same row carries legalities.status.
description: A card printing stands in a per-format legality relation to each play format, at printing grain rather than at game-piece grain.

connection_condition: cards.artist holds the artist name as free text; there is no artist table and no identifier to join on.
description: A card printing is credited to an artist, but the connection is a text value rather than a structural reference.

connection_condition: cards.name holds the card name; printings that share a name are separate rows, often in different sets.
description: A card name maps to one or more card printings, so a name-based question and a printing-based question do not have the same answer population.

connection_condition: cards.isTextless = 1 selects a subset of card printings.
description: A textless card is a kind of card printing; the 115 flagged printings are a subset of all printings and any aggregate over cards contains them.

connection_condition: cards.isStorySpotlight = 1 selects a subset of card printings.
description: A Story Spotlight card is a kind of card printing; the 104 flagged printings are a subset of all printings.

connection_condition: cards.isPromo = 1 selects a subset of card printings.
description: A promotional printing is a kind of card printing; the 5588 flagged printings are a subset of all printings.

connection_condition: foreign_data.language and set_translations.language draw on the same language vocabulary; Italian, German, French, Chinese Simplified and others appear in both columns.
description: Card-level and set-level translation languages express the same business concept of a localization language. A question that names a language should be recognised against either column, while the two data sources answer different questions.

connection_condition: Derived from the pair of columns cards.cardKingdomFoilId and cards.cardKingdomId in the same row.
description: Foil availability is a store-listing attribute of a card printing rather than a stored flag, so it must be reconstructed from the identifier pair.

connection_condition: cards.types and cards.originalType describe the same type line at different granularity; every printing with originalType 'Artifact' also carries Artifact in types, but 2162 further printings carry Artifact only inside a multi-type list.
description: The normalized type list and the printed type line are alternative representations of a card's type, and a type filter written against one does not select the same population as the other.
A card percentage is derived by dividing the count of card printings satisfying the question's condition by the count over the question's stated population and scaling to a percentage.
Ruling count is derived as the number of ruling records sharing a card printing's uuid; the 'most ruling information' question is a maximum over this derived count.
